title: Introduction to Advanced Manufacturing
description: The course will introduce the concepts and standards used in modern advanced manufacturing, including employability soft skills, and careers. Topics include a brief history of manufacturing, 21st century employability skills, safety and hazardous waste, manufacturing processes, company organizational structure, career opportunities, legal requirements for manufacturing, common manufacturing standards, process control techniques, problem solving, and automatic manufacturing. Field trips will be required.
outcomes: Identify potential careers in advanced manufacturing
content: Digital Fluency (Digital, Communication, Technology, and Security)
lab: Practice Employability Skills (Adaptability, Collaboration, Communication, Digital Fluency, Analysis/Solution Mindset)
Follow a Manufacturing Instruction to Assemble a Product (e.g. IKEA product)
Analyze a Manufacturer’s Assembly Instructions for Process Improvement
Problem Solving: Find Alternatives to an Assembly Failure
Identify Methods to Achieve ISO Safety Standards
assignments: Read assigned textbook chapters and prepare for presentations.
